description: Only results classified after 12th (13th onward) are included. Results classified exactly 12th are excluded.

c.request: Looking only at back-of-the-field results, using 12 as the cutoff on classification order (`positionOrder`), and matching each result to its race: for each race (grouped by race ID and race name), show the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last. Only results classified after 12th (13th onward) are included. Results classified exactly 12th are excluded.
c.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), '') AS INTEGER)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), '') AS INTEGER)) IS NULL), avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: Considering only race results whose classification order (`positionOrder`) is greater than 12, each matched to its race, show for each race (grouped by race ID and race name) the race ID, the race name, and the average number of laps completed (`laps`, ignoring missing values). List the 10 races with the highest average first, with any race lacking an average placed last.
a.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(res.laps), ''), '\N') AS INTEGER)) AS avgLaps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avgLaps IS NULL, avgLaps DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: For each race (grouped by race ID and race name), show the race ID, race name, and average `laps` (ignoring missing values) using only results with `positionOrder > 12` (excluding `positionOrder = 12`), then list the top 10 races by average descending with NULL averages last.
b.sql: SELECT r.raceId, ra.name, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(r.laps, '') AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.positionOrder > 12 AND r.positionOrder <> 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, ra.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each race (grouped by race ID and race name), show the race ID, race name, and average `laps` (ignoring missing values) using only results with `positionOrder > 12` (excluding `positionOrder = 12`), then list the top 10 races by average descending with NULL averages last.

d.request: For each race, grouped by `raceId` and `name`, average `laps` over `results` rows with `positionOrder > 12` (excluding `positionOrder = 12`) and non-null `laps`, showing the race ID, name, and average, ordered by average descending with NULL averages last, limited to 10 rows.
d.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder > 12 AND res.positionOrder <> 12 AND res.laps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10;
